title: Research Fellow in Cardiovascular Stem Cell Research
field: Cardiovascular stem cell research, congenital heart defects
about: Research Fellow at Monash University's Clayton campus investigating the molecular and functional mechanisms underlying congenital heart defects, using human stem cell-derived cardiomyocyte and cardiac organoid models with electrophysiology and genomics (per aggregator).
card_alt: Card for the Research Fellow in Cardiovascular Stem Cell Research at Monash University, Clayton (Melbourne), Australia, deadline 3 Nov 2026. The photo shows the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge at dusk in Sydney, a different city from the offer.
